title: Yes Bank BYOC Cashback credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A BYOC Cashback variant providing tailored cashback on user-selected categories, milestone vouchers, and flexible redemption options.

eligibility: Spend ₹50,000 or more in the previous quarter (Jan-Mar, Apr-Jun, Jul-Sep, Oct-Dec), you automatically qualify for this privilege in the subsequent quarter (Apr-Jun, Jul-Sep, Oct-Dec, Jan-Mar).
